articles.title: The Brake That Fell When the Air Was Lost
articles.summary: A mine cage relies on air pressure to apply its brake, until a ruptured pipe reveals which way the machine chooses when it fails.
articles.summaryZh: 矿场升降笼原本靠气压推住刹车，一根管子破裂后，众人才发现故障发生时机器会选择哪一边。
storyParagraphs: Mountain Mine replaced its hoist cage before the winter contract. In the old arrangement, air pressure held a long lever against the winding-drum brake; losing pressure released it. Mechanic Liang Qiu asked what would happen if a hose split. The owner pointed to ore carts waiting at the shaft and offered her a completion bonus. Reversing the mechanism meant three days without lifting, so he approved only stronger joints and a new pressure gauge. Liang had already sketched the reversed arrangement, but the owner rolled the drawing around the new gauge and locked it in his desk. The bonus envelope carried her name; three days of delay would cancel it.

For six weeks the gauge stayed green and output rose. Operators grew used to releasing the cage as soon as pressure returned. During a rainstorm, a falling stone cut a hose between two perfect joints. Pressure vanished, the lever relaxed, and the loaded cage slid two levels before striking an empty platform. Nobody was inside, but the platform folded, ore blocked the shaft, and the promised shipment missed its train. The undamaged gauge still pointed at zero. Early-shift workers spent three days shovelling ore from the bent platform. One cart wheel remained trapped under it, and the railway charged storage for every missed wagon. The damage had begun with a hose no stronger joint could protect.

The owner wanted the hose patched before morning. Liang locked the control handle and refused to sign. She redirected springs and a suspended weight so their natural force applied the brake; normal pressure and a valid command were now needed to lift it. Loss of air, electricity, or the control line sent the cage toward a stopped condition. Restart required inspection and deliberate reset instead of returning automatically when pressure flickered back.

The change cost another contract week. Separate cases—people aboard, ore aboard, maintenance, sensor error, and a jammed cage—were reviewed because stopping was not harmless in every situation. Position sensing, inspection, and test stops supported the chosen response. The owner signed the lost-shipment invoice beside each review. Liang never claimed the cage would keep serving after a fault; she required the identified fault to move first toward the less dangerous state. During the first test, the new brake stopped on a simulated power loss but one position signal disagreed. Liang kept the shaft closed another day until the discrepancy was found, refusing to turn a successful stop into proof that every part was ready.

Half a year later another hose burst between levels. The cage stopped hard and miners waited forty minutes for a controlled rescue, cursing the delay but walking out. Liang hung the split hose above the brake handle. Beneath it lay the old completion-bonus envelope, still unopened and grey with dust.
storyParagraphsZh: 山矿赶在冬季合同前更换升降笼。旧装置依靠气压把长杆压在卷轮刹车上，失压便松开。修械师梁秋问，气管若破会怎样。矿主指着井口等待的矿车，答应按期完成便发奖金；反转机构要停运三天，他只批准加固接头、增装压力表。梁秋早画好反向机构，矿主却把图纸卷在新压力表外，锁进抽屉。奖金信封上写着她的名字，只要延误三天就会取消。
六周里，指针一直在绿色区，出矿量也上升。操作员习惯气压一恢复便放行。一个雨夜，落石割破两只完好接头之间的气管。压力消失，长杆松开，满载矿笼下滑两层，撞上空装卸台才停。笼内无人，平台却折叠，矿石堵住井筒，约定货物错过火车。没损坏的表仍指着零。早班工人花三天从折弯平台下铲矿，一只矿车轮仍卡在里面；铁路还对每节误期车厢收取堆存费。事故从接头以外的气管开始，再牢的接头也护不到那里。
矿主要梁秋补管后天亮前复工。她锁住控制柄，拒绝签字，改用弹簧和悬重的自然力量压紧刹车；只有气压正常、命令有效时，刹车才被提起。失去气源、电力或控制线，矿笼先朝停止状态移动；压力忽明忽灭后，也不能自动重启，必须检查并手动复位。
改造又损失一周合同。载人、载矿、检修、传感器错误和卡笼分别复核，因为停下本身并非每种情形都无害；位置检测、检查和试刹共同支持预定反应。矿主把误期账单逐张签在复核表旁。梁秋没有承诺故障后仍能照常工作，只要求已识别故障先把机器带向伤害较小处。第一次试验中，新刹车在模拟断电时确实停住，一只位置讯号却不一致。梁秋继续封井一天，直到找到差异，没有把一次成功停车当成所有部分都已妥当的证明。
半年后，另一根气管在半空爆裂。升降笼猛地停住，矿工等了四十分钟才按程序获救，骂着延误却都走了出来。梁秋把破管挂在刹车手柄上方，下面压着那只从未打开、已经落灰的完工奖金信封。
explanationParagraphs: Fail-safe design begins with specific hazards and failure modes, then defines a lower-risk state for loss of energy, broken connections, or erroneous action. In the story, springs apply the brake and air pressure releases it, so loss of energy defaults to stopping. This is not the same as continuing normal service after a fault, which is fault tolerance. Diagnostics, independent channels, interlocks, tests, and manual reset help ensure the intended safe response actually occurs.
explanationParagraphsZh: 故障安全设计先依据具体危害和故障模式，规定失能、断线、误动作等情况应进入何种较低风险状态。故事中的弹簧施加制动、气压释放制动，使失去能源时默认停车。它不等于系统在故障后仍正常服务；后者属于容错。诊断、独立通道、联锁、试验与人工复位常用于保证预定安全行为确实发生。

articles.title: The Axle That Refused to Bend
articles.summary: A cartwright chooses the axle that stays straightest under load, then learns at the first deep rut that stiffness, strength, and resistance to breaking are not the same.
articles.summaryZh: 车匠为庆典挑中一根受压时最直的车轴，却在第一处深坑前发现，直、强与不易断并不是一回事。
storyParagraphs: The county had to carry a bronze statue to the jubilee, and cartwright Ishihara would lose the royal order if the wagon was late. He placed three axle samples on supports and loaded each with the same stone. The polished black bar barely bent. An older smith warned that it returned no information before breaking, but Ishihara chose it. 'If it refuses to bend,' he said, 'it must be strongest.'

Empty-road trials rewarded him. The wheels ran straight and the measuring line stayed exact. On parade morning, one wheel dropped into a deep rut while the opposite side remained on stone. The axle gave a short crack and separated cleanly. The statue rolled into mud, losing the tip of its nose. The other two samples, rejected as soft, still lay in the shop and had returned straight after their test loads were removed. The parade crowd scattered from the leaning load, and four horses strained against the tilted wagon until workers freed them. Ishihara paid for a crane to lift the statue and spent the night washing mud from its face, unable to replace the missing bronze tip.

The smith made strips of equal length and area and hung weights in steps. Ishihara marked the load against the extension. Under small loads, one strip lengthened little and returned; another lengthened more but also returned. Beyond a point, a strip stayed bent after unloading. At the end, the black sample snapped with little additional stretch, while another drew out before breaking.

Ishihara had used one part of the curve—the initial slope—to answer several different questions. The board separated resistance to elastic deformation, the point where permanent change began, the highest load reached, and the deformation absorbed before fracture. A stiff bar was not automatically the most ductile or toughest. The broken axle's sharp shoulder had also concentrated the wheel load into a narrow region.

The county demanded an identical black replacement before the rescheduled parade. Ishihara instead admitted the mistake and lost half his fee. The smith selected material and diameter for the actual loads, rounded the abrupt shoulder, and marked likely damage sites for inspection. Geometry, temperature, loading rate, and previous damage joined the material sample in the decision; the bench strip alone did not become the whole wagon.

The statue's nose could not be recast in time. Workers turned the chipped side toward the rear and used the saved bronze to make a reference mark on the new axle. Ishihara drove the wagon loaded with sand through the rut, then checked whether the mark returned before agreeing to carry the statue.

During the second parade, the axle bent slightly in the same hollow and straightened as the wheel climbed out. Ishihara knelt, ran one finger over the bronze mark, and waved the wagon forward. The statue passed with its missing nose facing the cheering crowd behind it.
storyParagraphsZh: 县里要用四轮大车运铜像参加庆典，若误期，车匠石原就会失去王室订单。他把三根同长车轴架起，各压同样石块。黑亮钢轴几乎不弯。老铁匠提醒，它断前不会给多少迹象，石原仍选了它：“连弯都不弯，当然最结实。”
空车试跑像在奖励他。车轮笔直，轴上测量线毫无变化。游行清晨，一只轮陷入深坑，另一侧仍压在石面。车轴发出短促脆响，齐齐断开；铜像滚进泥里，鼻尖磕掉一块。另两根被嫌软的样品仍在工棚，卸掉试验石块后早已恢复直线。人群从倾斜铜像旁散开，四匹马被歪车拖住，直到工人解套。石原付钱雇吊机扶正铜像，又整夜洗去脸上泥水，缺失的铜鼻尖却再也找不到。
老铁匠把同长同粗的金属条逐步挂重，石原把载荷与伸长画在木板上。小重量下，一根伸得少并能复原，另一根伸得多也能复原；超过某点，有的卸载后仍弯。最后，黑色样品没再伸长多少便断了，另一根却先拉长很远。
石原原先只用曲线开头的斜率回答了好几个不同问题。木板把弹性变形有多难、何时开始永久改变、最高承受载荷和断前吸收多少变形分开。很硬的杆不自动拥有更好的延展与抗断能力；旧轴上突兀的肩部，还把车轮力量挤在一小段。
县令要求在延期游行前复制同样黑轴。石原承认选错，失去一半工钱。铁匠按实际载荷选择材料与直径，磨圆尖锐肩部，并标出需要检查的易损处。结构形状、温度、加载速度和旧伤同材料样品一起进入决定，台架细条不再替整辆车作保证。
铜像鼻尖来不及重铸，工人把缺口转向车后，又用省下的铜在新轴刻一道基准。石原先装满沙袋驶过深坑，确认刻线能否回位，才同意让铜像上车。
第二次游行，新轴在同一凹坑里微微弯曲，车轮爬出后又恢复。石原跪下摸过铜色基准，挥手放行。铜像经过街口时，缺失的鼻尖正朝向身后欢呼的人群。
explanationParagraphs: Stress describes internal force per unit area, while strain describes relative deformation. Their relationship reveals elastic stiffness, yielding, plastic deformation, hardening, and fracture. High stiffness means less deformation under a given stress; it does not guarantee high yield strength, ultimate strength, ductility, or toughness. Geometry, notch concentrations, temperature, loading rate, and material history also affect structural behaviour.
explanationParagraphsZh: 应力表示材料内部单位面积承受的内力，应变表示相对变形；两者关系揭示弹性刚度、屈服、塑性变形、硬化和断裂。刚度高只代表同一应力下变形较小，不等于屈服强度、极限强度、延性或韧性都高。结构行为还受几何、缺口造成的集中、温度、加载速度和材料历史影响。

articles.title: The Hook That Was Never Overloaded
articles.summary: A dock hook lifts only half its rated load each time, yet cracks from an old scratch after more than eight thousand lifts.
articles.summaryZh: 码头吊钩每次都只提额定重量的一半，却在第八千多次起吊时，从一道旧划痕处突然裂开。
storyParagraphs: River Port's great lifting hook passed an annual proof load heavier than any timber crate. Foreman Du needed every crane working through the export rush, and the hook had survived five years. When a chain cut a shallow notch near its curve, he painted over it rather than lose a shift. The next proof test still held, so he used the stamped certificate to silence the crane operator's concern.

Months later, during roughly the eight-thousandth ordinary lift, a crate had barely left the deck when the hook broke at the painted notch. It fell into the hold and crushed a shipment of porcelain. No recorded lift exceeded the limit. Du accused the test weight of being false and ordered a new, heavier one, intending to prove the remaining hooks safe before the insurer arrived. Crane work stopped while sailors counted broken plates in the hold. The insurer photographed the painted notch and suspended coverage for every hook with an undocumented repair. Du's quick coat of paint now idled the whole quay.

A surveyor washed away the paint and applied an inspection dye. A thin red line entered from the old notch. Curved bands across the fracture showed a crack advancing by small amounts under repeated changes in load; only the final remaining section had separated under the ordinary crate. One heavy survival event had not represented thousands of smaller cycles, their order, or the surface damage where they concentrated.

Du turned the reopening board face down and stopped all three cranes for inspections suited to hidden cracks. Two ships left for another port while his crew opened every painted repair. A second hook showed a short line at its shoulder. It had never exceeded its permitted load either. Merchants shouted from the gate as inspection tents went up. Du paid idle crews and storage for cargo left on shore. When the second red line appeared, he placed it beside the first fracture on the insurer's table rather than asking for another proof load.

Hooks were thereafter tracked by lifts and load history, not only by their single heaviest crate. Damaged surfaces and sharp transitions received attention, higher-risk regions were examined at defined intervals using appropriate qualified methods, and components retired under a life-management plan. Important loads gained a secondary catch. The details depended on material, geometry, environment, and validated engineering practice rather than the foreman's new favourite number.

After each hundred lifts, Du cut a notch into a wooden counter board. The old hook's painted fracture was bolted above it, its red inspection line still visible. When the next shipmaster offered a bonus to skip an overdue check, Du placed the bonus coin into the lowest notch and stopped the crane.
storyParagraphsZh: 河港大吊钩每年都通过一次重载检验，试铁比任何木箱都重。出口旺季里，领班杜成需要每台吊机不停运，那只钩也已连续五年合格。铁链在弯处划出浅痕时，他用油漆盖住，免得损失一个班次。下一次试铁仍吊得住，他便用合格章压下操作员的担心。
几个月后，大约第八千次普通起吊，木箱刚离甲板，吊钩就在油漆痕处断开，落进船舱砸碎一批瓷器。记录里没有一次超重。杜成认定试铁重量有假，命人准备更重的一块，打算在保险员到港前证明其余吊钩安全。吊机停下，水手在舱底清点碎瓷。保险员拍下涂漆缺口，暂停承保所有有未记录修补的吊钩。杜成当初省下一个班次的油漆，如今让整座码头停工。
验船师洗去油漆，使用适当检测显示断口。细红线从旧划痕向里伸，一圈圈弧纹记录裂缝在反复载荷变化下逐次前进；只剩最后一小段金属，才在普通木箱下断开。一次扛住重物的结果，没有代表几千次循环、先后顺序和表面缺口的作用。
杜成把复工牌翻到背面，停掉三台吊机，改用适合隐裂的检查。两艘货船驶向别港，他的班组则把所有涂漆修补逐一打开。第二只吊钩的肩部也显出短线，它同样从未超过允许载荷。检查帐篷搭起时，商人在门外叫骂。杜成照付停工班组和岸上货物仓租。第二条红线出现后，他把它放到保险员桌上的旧断口旁，没有再要求吊一次更重试铁。
此后吊钩按起吊次数和载荷历史管理，不只记最重木箱。受损表面与尖锐过渡得到处理，高风险部位由合格人员按既定间隔和适当方法检查，零件依寿命方案退役，重要货物还有第二道承接。具体做法仍须按材料、形状、环境与经验证工程要求决定，不靠领班新喜欢的一个数字。
每完成一百次起吊，杜成就在木牌刻一道短线。旧钩涂过漆的断口钉在最上方，红色检测线仍看得见。下一位船主拿奖金求他跳过到期检查，他把金币塞进木牌最低一道刻痕，停下吊机。
explanationParagraphs: Material fatigue is progressive damage caused by repeated or fluctuating loads. Cracks can initiate and grow at stresses far below those required for a single static failure. Life depends on stress amplitude, mean stress, cycle count, load sequence, surface defects, geometric concentrations, environment, and residual stress. A static proof test cannot replace cyclic testing, inspection, life management, and damage-tolerant design.
explanationParagraphsZh: 材料疲劳是反复或波动载荷造成的渐进损伤，裂纹可在远低于一次静载破坏水平的应力下萌生并扩展。寿命受应力幅、平均应力、循环次数、载荷顺序、表面缺陷、几何集中、环境与残余应力影响。静态强度试验不能替代循环试验、定期检查、寿命管理和损伤容限设计。

articles.title: The Arch Whose Every Stone Passed
articles.summary: Every arch stone from twenty workshops passes its wooden gauge, yet the final stone will not fit when the pieces meet.
articles.summaryZh: 二十家石坊交来的拱石全都通过木尺检验，合在一起时，最后一块却怎么也放不进去。
storyParagraphs: The new market arch had to stand before the autumn fair. Twenty quarries each cut one voussoir from a drawing that allowed a narrow variation in length. Inspector Ma checked every stone between two marks on one wooden rule and stamped all twenty. Each supplier was paid by accepted piece, so cutters sensibly worked near the generous side of the allowed range to avoid making a stone too short. Ma's rule had been copied from a master kept in town, but each quarry used its copy through rain, dust, and repeated planing. Nobody compared the copies before work began. The identical acceptance stamp made their small drift invisible.

At the crown, the final key stone was a finger too wide. Every quarry owner raised a valid acceptance stamp. Their local rules had worn differently, the central reference had not travelled with the drawing, and nineteen small high-side choices had accumulated around the ring. Workers hammered until one edge chipped, but the stone still would not enter. The fair committee began hanging banners from scaffolding to hide the open arch. Two more blows opened a hairline crack along the crown stone. Workers lowered it by rope, and the scaffold remained across the market road. Traders who had paid for arch-side stalls demanded their fees back.

An angry magistrate ordered every future dimension made exact. The senior mason placed the chipped key stone on his desk. Stone, tools, measurement, temperature, and moisture all varied; demanding equal precision on hidden backs, carved flowers, and closing faces would miss the fair and multiply cost. The mason left the impossible promise unsigned, marked the faces that truly governed closure, and forfeited his on-time bonus. To prove the cost, he timed one flower carving and one mating face. Tightening both equally multiplied hours without improving the fit. The magistrate crossed out his exactness order when the revised schedule showed winter.

The team checked wooden rules against one metal reference, centred production instead of clustering at one edge, tightened dimensions that accumulated toward closure, and performed intermediate trial assemblies. Non-mating backs and decoration kept wider allowances. The final gap included enough clearance to install the key without leaving the arch loose. These choices followed function, fit, process capability, measurement uncertainty, and consequence, not a universal number.

Opening morning arrived one day late. The key stone slid into place when the mason withdrew a thin wooden shim; no hammer struck it. A line of sun remained in the designed joint. Inspector Ma hung the twenty old acceptance stamps from the scaffold rope, where their small differences clicked together in the wind.
storyParagraphsZh: 新市场拱门必须在秋集前立起。二十家石坊各按图纸制作一块拱石，长度允许有一线出入。验收人马师傅用同一把木尺检查，每块都落在两道刻痕之间，便逐一盖章。石坊按合格件收钱，为免石头太短，工匠自然都靠允许范围偏大一侧加工。马师傅的木尺原本照城里母尺复制，各石坊却在雨水、石粉与反复刨磨中使用自己的副尺，开工前无人再核对。同一枚合格印，把细小漂移全遮住。
合到顶部时，最后楔石宽了整整一指。每位石坊主都举着有效合格印；各地木尺磨损不同，共同基准也没随图纸送到，十九次偏大选择又沿拱圈累积。工人敲缺一角，石头仍进不去。秋集委员会只好先在脚手架挂彩旗，遮住拱顶空口。再敲两锤，冠石沿边出现细裂。工人用绳把它放下，脚手架继续横在市场路上；预付拱门边摊位费的商贩纷纷要求退款。
县令大怒，命令以后每个尺寸一丝不差。老石匠把缺角楔石放到桌上：石材、工具、测量、温湿度都会变化，若背面、花纹和闭合面都追求同样精度，不仅赶不上秋集，费用也会翻倍。老石匠没有在那份完美承诺上签名，只圈出真正决定闭合的配合面，并放弃按期奖金。他分别给花纹和配合面计时，证明两处同样收紧只会增加工时，不会改善闭合。修订工期排到冬天，县令才划掉“一丝不差”的命令。
团队把木尺同金属母尺核对，不再把尺寸总做在范围一侧；会沿闭合方向累积的尺寸收紧，并增加中途整体试装。与配合无关的背面和装饰继续放宽，最终接缝既留出安装余量，又不让拱门松动。功能、配合、过程能力、测量不确定和后果共同决定这些范围，不靠一个万能数字。
开门日比计划晚了一天。老石匠抽走底下一片薄木垫，楔石自行落定，没有锤子碰它；设计好的缝里仍留一线日光。马师傅把二十枚旧合格印挂在脚手绳上，风吹时，细小差异一起碰响。
explanationParagraphs: Engineering tolerance permits controlled variation in dimensions, geometry, or performance while preserving function and manufacturability. Individually conforming parts do not guarantee a successful assembly because deviations can accumulate; process bias, gauge error, and environment also affect outcomes. Tolerances should follow functional sensitivity, fit, process capability, measurement uncertainty, and risk. Critical features may need tighter limits, while unnecessary precision elsewhere only raises cost.
explanationParagraphsZh: 工程公差允许尺寸、几何或性能在受控范围内变化，同时保证功能和可制造性。单件都合格，不代表装配一定成功，因为多个偏差可能叠加；过程偏向、量具误差和环境也会改变结果。公差应按功能敏感度、配合、过程能力、测量不确定性与风险分配，关键处收紧、非关键处无谓收紧只会增加成本。

articles.title: The Steadiest Ship Missed the Harbour
articles.summary: An owner deepens a ferry's keel and widens its hull until it resists every roll, then finds that it also resists its helmsman.
articles.summaryZh: 船主为了让渡船再也不倾斜，不断加深龙骨、加宽船身，最后它顶住了侧风，也拒绝听从舵手。
storyParagraphs: Passengers had once gone pale when ferry owner Du Cheng's boat rolled in cross-seas. To win the harbour licence, he promised the next vessel would be 'steady as the quay'. He widened the hull, lowered weights, and fitted a deep fixed fin. The designer warned that the existing rudder might lack authority at low speed, but redesign would miss the tender. Du submitted the calm-water trial: a teacup had not moved on the table.

On the first licensed trip, a side wind pushed the loaded boat toward the channel edge. The deck stayed nearly level, yet the bow would not turn toward the entrance. The deep fin and broad hull resisted yaw while the small rudder produced little effect at low speed. The harbour slid past to starboard. Passengers cheered the lack of rolling until they learned the boat needed another hour outside to turn around.

On the second approach, the helmsman applied full rudder early. Nothing happened at first. As speed rose, the turn arrived too strongly and the ferry struck the wooden fender. No one was hurt, but cargo shifted and passengers spent two more hours aboard. Du nailed the unspilled teacup photograph over the damage report and blamed the helmsman.

The designer brought two small models to the basin. One returned rapidly after a sideways disturbance but traced a wide circle under the same rudder command; the other rolled more, yet changed heading within the harbour width. Du timed both instead of judging only their return to upright. The ability to settle after disturbance and the ability to follow a commanded change demanded separate evidence and could trade against each other.

The licence inspector required trials under empty and full load, low and higher speed, crosswind, and specified damage conditions. With the festival permit lying unsigned, Du sent the boat into the yard, returned the booked fares, and lost the licence bonus. Hull, weight location, fin area, and rudder authority were adjusted together. Festival families collected refunds at the ticket shed while the vessel sat on blocks. Du sold the decorative salon furniture to pay the yard and left the teacup photograph pinned to the bare wall.

The modified vessel still arrested its motion after a wave, but it also had enough control to turn before the breakwater. Limits remained for weather and load; the crew did not promise every manoeuvre in every sea. The chipped fender was mounted near the helm so a calm teacup could no longer serve as the only acceptance test.

On the next crosswind approach, the helmsman moved the tiller gently. The bow crossed the wind and aligned with the harbour; when he eased his hand, the motion settled. Du lifted the same cup from the table. A small ring travelled across the tea while the chipped fender hung steady above him.
storyParagraphsZh: 乘客曾在横浪里被旧渡船晃得脸白。船主杜成要争取港口执照，承诺新船“稳得像码头”，于是加宽船身、压低重物，又装上很深的固定鳍。设计师提醒，旧小舵在低速可能没有足够作用；改造却会错过投标。杜成提交了静水试航照片：桌上茶碗纹丝不动。
第一次持照载客，侧风把满载渡船推向航道边。甲板几乎不斜，船头却转不进港口。深鳍和宽船身强烈抗拒偏航，小舵在低速又没有足够效果。入口从右舷滑过去，乘客起初还庆幸船不晃，随后才知道必须在外湾多绕一小时。
第二次进港，舵手提前打满舵。船最初仍不转，速度起来后，迟到的转向突然过强，船身擦坏码头护木。无人受伤，货物却移位，乘客又被困两小时。杜成把那张茶水未洒的照片钉在事故报告上方，责怪舵手。
设计师把两只小模型放进水槽。一只受侧扰后很快回正，同样舵令下却画出大圈；另一只摆动稍多，却能在港池宽度内转向。杜成这次给两者计时，不再只看回正。受扰后能否收住运动，与能否按命令及时改变方向，需要分别验证，也可能彼此牵制。
执照官要求在空载、满载、低速、较高速度、横风和规定受损情形下试航。节庆许可迟迟没有签字，杜成便把船送进坞里，退还预订船票，也失去执照奖金。船身、载重位置、鳍面与舵的作用一起调整。节庆家庭在票房排队退款，渡船则架在坞墩上。杜成卖掉客舱装饰家具支付船厂费用，只把茶碗照片钉在空墙。
改好后的船仍能在浪后收住摆动，也有足够作用在防波堤前转弯；天气与载荷限制继续保留，船员不承诺每种海况都能完成每个动作。破损护木被挂在驾驶位附近，一只平静茶碗不再独自充当验收。
下一次横风进港，舵手轻推舵柄，船头越过风向对准入口；他松手时，运动慢慢定住。杜成端起同一只碗，茶面荡过一圈小纹，头顶缺角护木一动不动。
explanationParagraphs: Stability describes whether a vehicle's motion after disturbance remains bounded, decays, or returns toward an operating state. Control describes whether its actuators have enough authority and response to achieve commanded changes. Stronger passive stability can improve disturbance resistance while also increasing resistance to turning or reducing manoeuvrability. Design must examine both recovery behaviour and control authority across speeds, loads, environments, delays, and failures.
explanationParagraphsZh: 稳定性描述车辆或船舶受扰后的运动是否有界、衰减或回到运行状态；操纵性描述执行器能否以足够权限和速度实现命令变化。更强的被动稳定可能提高抗扰，也可能增加转向阻力或降低机动。设计需在不同速度、载荷、环境、延迟和故障下，同时检查恢复特性与控制能力。

articles.title: The Cargo Boat That Won the Race
articles.summary: A new cargo boat outruns every vessel in the harbour while empty, then needs two extra voyages to deliver the same grain.
articles.summaryZh: 一艘新货船在空载试航中快过全港，却为了送完同一批粮食，多跑了两趟。
storyParagraphs: Merchant Xu An needed the royal grain contract to save his yard. He commissioned a long narrow vessel with a knife-shaped bow and polished boards. Empty, it crossed the harbour faster than every old cargo boat and used little fuel for the trial. Xu painted the winning time across its sail. The shipwright asked how many sacks the contract required per week; Xu answered that the fastest boat would simply make more trips.

Loaded with grain, the narrow hull reached its draft and stability limit at sixty percent of an older boat's cargo. Xu ordered the captain to hold trial speed so the painted promise remained true. Fuel flow rose sharply, the bow struck on waves, and one wet crossing required another reduction in sacks. The first delivery arrived on time, but only because the crew sailed twice through the night.

On the third trip an engine bearing overheated and the crew missed the tide. Xu could reduce speed or hire another boat and expose his claim. He insisted on speed. By week-end the new vessel had made three extra voyages, burned more fuel, paid more crew hours, and still left eighty sacks at the quay. The royal clerk measured delivered grain, not the first arrival time, and withheld the contract payment. The overheated bearing needed replacement before the vessel could sail again. Grain waited under rented canvas, and rain spoiled the outer row. Xu paid the farmers before receiving a coin from the palace.

The captain put two rows on a slate. The old boat moved more slowly but carried more; when both boats reduced speed slightly in the same current, resistance and fuel demand fell enough that sacks delivered per barrel improved. Xu added full-load fuel, cargo, number of trips, waiting for weather, and crew time. The empty-race number had described one condition, not the useful transport service.

The shipwright kept smooth lines but reshaped the stern and propeller around common loads, adjusted width and operating speed, and scheduled hull cleaning. Routes avoided the strongest opposing current where timing allowed. Xu sold the polished racing mast to pay the redesign and accepted a smaller seasonal contract. Safety, stability, engine limits, weather, and cargo delivery remained in the comparison; no one chased a low resistance number by removing needed capacity. The captain then repeated a loaded route at two permitted speeds and posted delivered sacks and fuel side by side. The slower run arrived later but completed the weekly quantity with one fewer voyage.

Before the next tender, Xu cut the old record from the sail. A tailor made it into a small flag reading: one barrel, four hundred and twenty sacks delivered. The flag was shorter than the missing royal pennant, and it flew above a hold filled to its marked line.
storyParagraphsZh: 船商许安必须拿到王城粮运合约，才能救回船厂。他订造一艘细长新船，船头像刀，船板能照出人影。空载试航时，它轻易超过所有旧货船，耗油也少。许安把最快时间写上船帆。造船师问每周要送多少袋粮，他说最快的船多跑几趟就行。
装粮后，细船为保持吃水和稳定，只能装旧船六成。许安仍命船长维持试航速度，好让帆上的承诺不落空。燃料流量猛增，船头不断拍浪，一次湿冷航程还得再减货。首批准时抵达，只因船员连夜跑了两次。
第三趟，发动机轴承过热，船又错过潮水。许安可以降速，也可以租船、承认宣传失实；他仍坚持速度。一周结束，新船多跑三航次，烧掉更多油，付出更多工时，码头却还剩八十袋。王室书记只数交付粮袋，不看第一船多快，因而扣住合约款。过热轴承必须更换，船才能再开。粮袋只能罩着租来的帆布等待，雨水仍毁掉最外一排。王宫一枚钱都没付，许安先赔给农户。
船长在石板列两行。旧船虽慢，却装得多；两船在同一水流里稍微降速后，水的阻碍与燃料需求都明显下降，每桶油送达的粮袋反而增加。许安这才把满载油耗、载货量、航次数、候天气时间和船员工时放到一起。空船竞速只描述一种条件，没有描述完整运输。
造船师保留流畅外形，却按常用载荷重做船尾、螺旋桨、船宽与工作速度，并安排清理船底；条件允许时避开最强逆流。许安卖掉光亮竞速桅杆支付改造，只接到较小季节合同。安全、稳定、发动机限制、天气和送达货物都留在比较里，没有人靠删掉必要能力来追求漂亮数字。船长又在两种允许速度下重跑满载航线，把送达袋数与油耗并列张贴。较慢一趟虽晚到，却让全周少跑一次便完成数量。
下一次投标前，许安剪下帆上的旧纪录。裁缝把它做成小旗，写着“一桶油，送达四百二十袋”。小旗比缺席的王室长旗短得多，却飘在一座装到标线的货舱上方。
explanationParagraphs: Drag is resistance to motion through a fluid, arising from surface friction, pressure differences, flow separation, wave making, and lift-related effects. It changes with speed, shape, roughness, scale, and flow regime. Transport efficiency must be defined by useful service over a complete journey. Low empty drag or high maximum speed does not guarantee the least energy per unit of cargo because load, propulsion efficiency, stability, safety, weather, and trip count alter the result.
explanationParagraphsZh: 阻力是物体穿过流体时受到的运动抵抗，来源包括表面摩擦、压差、流动分离、造波与升力相关作用，并随速度、形状、粗糙度、尺度和流态变化。运输效率必须以有用服务和完整航程定义；低空载阻力或最高速度不保证单位货物最省，因为载荷、推进效率、稳定、安全、天气与航次都会改变结果。

articles.title: The Two Pumps That Fell Silent Together
articles.summary: A ferry owner installs two bilge pumps and believes leaks are no longer dangerous, overlooking the low-mounted switchboard they share.
articles.summaryZh: 渡船装了两台排水泵，船主以为漏水不再可怕，却没有注意它们共用同一块低处配电板。
storyParagraphs: When the strait ferry was refitted, owner Bosun installed two bilge pumps. The safety inspector asked about flooding; Bosun tapped the deck and said, 'If one fails, the other works.' Both pumps were identical, low in adjacent compartments, connected to one switchboard, and serviced by the same mechanic on the same day. The arrangement was cheap, tidy, and allowed the ferry to return before the summer rush. A separate engine-driven option had been removed from the estimate because it cost more and occupied cargo space. Bosun used the saving to refurbish the passenger saloon, where two brass pump symbols were painted above the door.

One night driftwood opened a cargo-seam. The first pump started, but rising water reached the low switchboard; both pump lamps went dark. The second machine had no broken part and still remained silent. Crew formed a bucket line while wet cargo shifted against the bulkhead. The ferry limped home, losing the entire lower shipment and its next three sailings. Bosun blamed the unused second pump for failing to be a proper spare. The saloon lights died with the pumps. Passengers stood ankle-deep near the stairs while crew passed buckets through the dark. One bucket struck the painted pair of pump symbols and left a muddy crescent across both.

The inspector laid two powerless cables beside the insurance claim. There were two machines but one electrical fate; one flood, one low location, or one maintenance error could silence the pair. With one night left before the tourist weekend, Bosun refused the third identical unit and ordered power and equipment rerouted into separated spaces. He refunded fares and watched a rival ferry carry the crowd.

One electric pump moved higher on an independent circuit, another used a separately supported drive, and a manual option remained. High water produced an alarm; valves and isolation were checked; crews periodically disabled the primary path and demonstrated that the remaining arrangement could take the specified duty. Added weight, inspection, switching behaviour, and maintenance burden entered the plan. In the maintenance book, the new pump received no check mark until the crew named a fault, isolated it, and emptied the test tank through the remaining path. In the first disablement drill, the alarm sounded but the alternate path failed to start because a closed valve had been missed. The inspector kept the ferry tied up until the crew found it, repeated the test, and recorded the switching time.

Before reopening, the inspector pulled the primary fuse without warning. The engine room fell quiet, then a separate turning sound began above the old waterline. Bosun bent over the bilge instead of applauding. The two cables from the flooded switchboard hung on a nail behind him, tied together by one black burn mark.
storyParagraphsZh: 海峡渡船翻修时，船主博森装了两台舱底泵。验船官问起进水，他拍着甲板说：“坏一台，还有一台。”两台泵型号相同，放在相邻低舱，接同一块配电板，又由同一名技工在同一天保养。这样便宜整齐，也能赶在暑期前复航。报价里原有一套分开驱动方案，因价高又占货位被删掉。博森把省下的钱翻新客舱，还在门上方画了两只黄铜泵标志。
一次夜航，漂木撞开货舱接缝。第一台泵启动不久，水便淹到低处配电板，两台泵的指示灯全灭；第二台没有任何零件损坏，却一样沉默。船员用桶接力，湿货还在舱壁旁移动。渡船勉强返港，底层货物全毁，接下来三航次也取消。博森责怪没用上的副泵不配叫备用。副泵沉默时，客舱灯也跟着熄灭。乘客在楼梯旁踩进没踝水，船员摸黑传桶；一只桶撞到那对泵标志，留下一道横跨两只标志的泥弧。
验船官把两根断电电缆放在索赔单旁。机器虽有两台，电力命运只有一条；一场进水、一个低处位置或一次保养错误，就能让它们一同沉默。离旅游周末只剩一夜，博森却退掉第三台同款，命人把电路与设备重铺到分隔舱位。他退还船票，眼看对手渡船载走人群。

一台电泵移到高处并用独立电路，另一台采用分开支持的驱动，船上仍留人工方案。高水位触发警报，隔离与阀门接受检查；船员定期停掉主路，证明剩余装置能承担规定任务。新增重量、检查、切换表现与保养负担也进入计划。检修本上，新泵直到船员写明一种故障、把它隔开并用余下路径排空试验水箱，才得到勾号。第一次停主路演练中，警报响了，替代路径却因一只遗漏的关闭阀没有启动。验船官继续扣船，直到船员找到原因、重做试验并记录切换时间。
复航前，验船官忽然拔掉主泵保险。机舱安静一瞬，旧水线以上随即传来另一处稳定转动声。博森没有鼓掌，只弯腰看舱底水位。身后钉着旧配电板的两根电缆，一道黑色烧痕把它们系在一起。
explanationParagraphs: Safety redundancy adds components, paths, information, or capacity so a system retains a critical function or degrades in a controlled way after specified faults. Copies need sufficient capacity and should avoid common supplies, locations, designs, or maintenance that create common-cause failure. Fault detection, isolation, and reliable transfer are also necessary. Redundancy adds weight, cost, and complexity, so regular testing must show that it will actually work when needed.
explanationParagraphsZh: 安全冗余增加组件、路径、信息或能力，使系统在指定故障后仍保留关键功能或受控降级。副本必须具备足够能力，并尽量避免共同电源、位置、设计或维护造成的共因失效；还需检测故障、隔离问题并可靠切换。冗余会增加重量、成本和复杂度，因此必须通过定期试验证明它在需要时真正可用。

articles.title: The Jar That Heated Last
articles.summary: The cannery's steam gauge passes its target mark, yet a row of lids later swells because the innermost jar never heated through.
articles.summaryZh: 罐头房的蒸汽表已经越过目标刻线，仓库里却还是鼓起了一排罐盖，因为最里面那罐从未热透。
storyParagraphs: During the tomato harvest, the Luo cannery had ten kettles to process each day or lose a supermarket order. The owner watched the steam cabinet's top gauge. As soon as it reached the red mark, he counted a short hold and opened the door, saving fifteen minutes per batch. Every lid sealed beautifully, and the faster line earned a bonus for three weeks. The coldest loads simply waited longer in the warehouse before anyone noticed.

A faint pop sounded from the back row. Several lids had swollen, all from a densely packed batch filled on a cold morning. The owner isolated only the visibly changed cans and proposed shipping the rest. The top gauge had never left its required mark. A qualified process specialist asked where that instrument measured and which part of the product warmed most slowly. Nobody could answer.

She placed calibrated data loggers in test containers at several positions and observed trials under the defined product and equipment conditions. Near the door, thinner product heated quickly. In the dense centre, the coldest, thickest container lagged. She compared a half load, a full load, and different initial temperatures, recording the whole heating and cooling history rather than one peak reading. The red top gauge told the truth about its own location only.

The owner faced the supermarket deadline, with its delivery truck waiting outside. He paid workers to stretch a rope across the storeroom and stack the entire affected lot behind it while specialists assessed the deviation. The order was lost. More lids swelled over the next two days, and their delayed popping carried through the closed storeroom.

A validated scheduled process was then established for the specific product, container, equipment, loading pattern, and required effect. Routine monitoring used the identified critical parameters, instruments were calibrated, and deviations triggered isolation and evaluation under predetermined qualified procedures. The cannery also controlled cooling and records. This was not a recipe transferable to another food or line; the specialist signed only the studied conditions.

Production slowed. The owner removed the piece-rate sign from above the cabinet and used its frame to hold the first full time-history chart. Workers could see the slowest curve reaching its required point after the top gauge had already crossed red. The chart stayed there through the season, gathering red pencil notes at every approved changeover.

At the next harvest peak, the top needle passed the red mark while trucks waited outside. The owner's hand rested on the door latch but did not pull. He waited until the approved record for the slow location completed, then signed the batch sheet with the pen once used to mark his fifteen-minute bonus.
storyParagraphsZh: 番茄丰收期，罗家罐头房每天必须完成十锅，否则就失去超市订单。老板只看蒸汽柜顶部温度表，指针到红线便计一小段时间后开门，每锅省下十五分钟。罐盖全都封得漂亮，快线也连续三周拿到奖金；最冷的产品只是在仓库多等了一阵，才让问题露面。
仓库后排传来轻响，几只罐盖鼓起，都来自一个寒冷清晨、装得很密的批次。老板只隔离外观异常的罐，打算其余照发，因为顶部表从未离开规定刻线。合格食品工艺人员问，那支表测的是哪里，产品哪处升温最慢。没有人答得出。
她在规定产品与设备条件下，把校准记录器放进不同位置的试验容器。门边较稀的产品很快升温，中央最冷、最稠的一罐却明显落后。她比较半柜、满柜和不同初温，记录整段加热与冷却过程，而非只抄峰值。顶部红表没有撒谎，它只报告自己的位置。
超市期限就在眼前，送货卡车正等在门外。老板付工钱让大家拉起粗麻隔离绳，把所有罐逐只搬到绳后，等待专业人员评估偏差。订单丢了。接下来两天，又有罐盖陆续鼓起，迟来的轻响穿过紧闭的库门。
此后，专业人员针对特定产品、容器、设备、装载方式和所需效果建立经验证程序。日常监测使用已确定的关键参数，仪器接受校准，偏离便按预定专业程序隔离并评估，冷却与记录也纳入。它不是能搬去另一种食品或生产线的配方，签字只覆盖实际验证过的条件。
生产速度下降了。老板拆掉柜门上方的计件奖牌，用那只框装起第一张完整时间曲线。工人都能看见：顶部表早已越过红线，最慢那条曲线仍在爬升。那张图挂了整季，每次获准转换都在曲线上多一道红铅笔记号。
下一次丰收高峰，卡车在门外等待，顶部指针又先过红线。老板把手放在门闩上，没有拉动；直到获批记录显示慢热位置完成，他才用过去登记十五分钟奖金的笔，在批次表上签名。
explanationParagraphs: Thermal processing applies a controlled time-temperature history to achieve a specified microbial, physical, or chemical effect. Lethality accumulates across the full curve rather than depending only on peak temperature. Product viscosity, starting temperature, container, and loading pattern alter heat transfer and the cold spot. A safe schedule requires validation, routine monitoring of critical parameters, calibrated instruments, controlled cooling, and defined handling of deviating batches.
explanationParagraphsZh: 热加工通过受控的时间—温度历程取得规定的微生物、物理或化学效果，致死作用会沿完整曲线累积，并非只看峰值。产品黏度、初温、容器和装载方式会改变传热与冷点。安全程序需经验证，日常还要监测关键参数、校准仪器、控制冷却，并对偏差批次执行隔离和处置。

articles.title: The Box That Looked Drier
articles.summary: A confectioner chooses travel goods by total moisture alone; the drier-looking cake moulds while glossy preserve remains sound in its jar.
articles.summaryZh: 点心商只按总水分挑选远行货物，外表较干的糕先长了霉，亮晶晶的果酱却仍安稳地封在罐里。
storyParagraphs: A confectioner won a contract to ship cakes across a humid strait. He compared two samples: glossy jam and a soft cake that felt dry. A moisture test also showed less total water in the cake. The ship sailed in two days, and a laboratory delay would forfeit the buyer's deposit. He left the jam behind, loaded the entire cake order, and stamped the boxes 'dry enough'.

By day ten, white growth appeared in several cake boxes while the retained jam still looked unchanged. The confectioner blamed the moisture test and demanded a lower number for the next batch. A food scientist sealed portions in small chambers until the surrounding air reached equilibrium with each food. The cake's chamber settled at a higher relative humidity; dissolved sugar had not removed the jam's water, but it changed how available that water was. The buyer opened the moulded box during inspection and rejected the whole shipment before unloading. Dock fees continued while the confectioner argued that the cakes had tested drier than jam.

She opened a filled pastry from the same shipment. Moisture had moved from the fruit centre into the crisp shell. The shell softened first, and change appeared near the seam. A whole-product moisture total hid both the difference between components and the direction of migration. Warmer storage accelerated several changes. The confectioner's dry fingertips had measured a surface at one moment, not the condition governing the package over its journey.

He returned the buyer's deposit and ordered the lot destroyed, even though the seasonal market would close without him. Workers emptied boxes while he recorded which recipes, components, package positions, and storage conditions had failed. The visible loss filled two carts; the retained glossy jam occupied one undamaged jar on his desk. A shorter route crossed the same humid harbour, so a new label could not repair the unknown shelf life. The confectioner broke his old stamp before the disposal carts left.

Qualified specialists then adjusted the product and barriers, selected packaging that limited external moisture exchange, and evaluated the intended shelf life under defined conditions. Each product was considered alongside acidity, ingredients, temperature, atmosphere, and relevant hazards. One food's number did not guarantee another, and the measurement was not used as a complete safety decision by itself.

Before the next voyage, the confectioner still touched a cake. He did not stamp the box. He waited until the chamber indicator stopped, checked the signed study for that product, and sealed the first carton. The old 'dry enough' stamp remained beneath the glass jar of jam, its ink swollen by the damp return voyage.
storyParagraphsZh: 点心商拿到一份穿越潮湿海峡的糕点合约。他比较两种样品：果酱黏亮，软糕摸起来更干；水分检测也显示软糕总水量较少。船两天后出发，若等实验室就会失去买家订金。他把果酱留在店里，整批装上软糕，并给箱子盖“足够干”。
航行第十天，几盒软糕出现白色霉变，留店果酱仍无明显变化。点心商责怪水分检测，要求下批把数字做得更低。食品人员把样品分别封进小室，等周围空气同食品达到平衡。软糕小室停在更高相对湿度；糖没有让果酱里的水消失，却改变了那些水有多容易参与变化。买家验货时打开霉变盒，整批尚未卸船便遭拒收。点心商仍拿“比果酱干”的数字争辩，码头费用却按时辰继续增加。
她又拆开同批夹心酥。水从水果馅逐渐移向脆皮，外皮先变软，接缝处也最早变化。整盒总水量既藏住不同部分的差别，也看不见迁移方向；较高温度还会加快多种变化。商人干燥的指尖只碰到某一刻的表面，没有测到包装在整段航程里的条件。
他退还订金，下令销毁整批货，即使当季市场会在他缺席时收摊。工人倒空箱子时，他逐项记录失败的配方、部位、包装位置与储存条件。看得见的损失装满两车，桌上那罐光亮果酱却仍完好。所谓短途也要穿过同一座潮湿港口，新标签补不了未知货架期。两辆销毁车还没离开，点心商先把旧印章木柄折断。
随后由合格人员调整产品与阻隔，选择限制外界湿气交换的包装，并在明确条件下评估预定货架期。每种产品还要同酸度、配料、温度、气氛与相关危险一起考虑；另一种食物的数字不能直接担保，这项测量本身也不承担完整安全决定。
再次装船前，点心商仍摸了摸软糕，却没有落印。他等小室指针停稳，核对该产品签字研究，才封上第一箱。旧“足够干”印章压在果酱玻璃罐下，印泥已被退货航程的潮气泡胀。
explanationParagraphs: Water activity expresses how available water in a food is for microbial growth, chemical reaction, and migration relative to pure water at the same temperature, and is related to equilibrium relative humidity. It differs from total moisture content. Sugar, salt, food structure, and temperature change water availability. Practical safety limits also depend on the organism, acidity, preservatives, atmosphere, packaging, and validated storage conditions.
explanationParagraphsZh: 水分活度表示食品中的水相对同温纯水有多容易参与微生物生长、化学反应和迁移，常与平衡相对湿度相联系；它不同于总水分含量。糖、盐、食品结构和温度会改变水的可利用程度。实际安全界限还取决于微生物、酸度、防腐剂、气氛、包装与经验证的储存条件。

articles.title: The Danger the Final Taste Could Not Find
articles.titleZh: 最后一口尝不出的危险
articles.summary: A pie shop entrusts safety to a final taster, until normal-tasting pies from one oven make customers at the spring fair ill.
articles.summaryZh: 肉饼坊把安全交给出炉后的试吃者，直到一炉味道正常的饼让春集上的客人接连病倒。
storyParagraphs: Before the spring fair, Chen's meat-pie bakery had to make several thousand pies a day. The owner stationed an experienced taster at the end of packing. One pie from each oven load was sampled; if its colour, smell, and flavour seemed normal, the batch shipped. The method was quick, visible to buyers, and helped Chen promise that no fair order would be late. He believed danger would reveal itself in the final bite.

On a rushed morning, ice around a meat delivery had melted and one burner in the oven corner failed. The taster received a well-heated pie from near the door and found nothing unusual. Pies from the cooler corner did not achieve the required process condition, yet looked and smelled alike. After the fair, customers became ill and every remaining package was recalled. Chen held up the tasting log; it proved only which pies had been eaten. The recall team worked through the night matching package codes while fair stalls closed. Chen refunded buyers and paid clinic claims. The taster, who had eaten a safe pie, kept asking why his own mouth had reported nothing.

The next morning, the food-safety team did not begin in the office. They followed one tray from the melting delivery ice, across the raw bench, through the oven and cooling room, to the packing table. Chen carried chalk. Workers hung a red card wherever danger could enter or grow, then removed cards where repaired cleaning, supplier checks, or separation could handle the problem. Two stayed on the wall: the established heating step at the cold oven corner and the cooling clock that no hand could judge by touch. Chen closed the raw bench beside the finished racks and paid carpenters for a partition, even though the work stopped production for another day.

On the first trial, a worker wrote the cold-corner reading beside the cart number. It missed the accepted condition, so she tied a red seal to the handle and packing stopped. Chen's delivery clerk pointed to the fair buyer waiting outside; the pies looked ready, and the renewal depended on that cart. Chen rolled it behind the hold chain. A mechanic found a partly blocked burner feed, while a second checked instrument confirmed the reading. During record review, one blank line exposed another cart that had passed without a reading. It was sealed too. The fair officer ordered both carts destroyed. Chen cut the seals under witness, tipped the pies into the disposal bin, and lost the renewal contract. He wrote the value of two carts beside their batch numbers. The taster's spoon stayed clean.

Months later the same corner burner failed. A reading triggered the planned response before the cart reached packing; a red hold tag stopped it while workers followed the bakery's documented process. Chen set down the tasting spoon and signed the tag. The old brass approval stamp hung above the table, clean and unused, while no customer had to become the alarm.
storyParagraphsZh: 春集前，陈记肉饼坊每天要做数千只饼。老板在包装末端安排老练试吃者，每炉抽一只；色、香、味正常便盖章出货。办法快，买家也看得见，还能保证集市订单不迟。陈老板相信，危险总会在最后一口露出破绽。
忙乱清晨，送肉车周围的冰融了，烤炉角落又有一只火头熄灭。试吃者拿到炉门边加热充分的饼，毫无异常；冷角那批没有达到规定过程条件，外观气味却一样。春集后，多名顾客不适，剩余包装全部召回。陈老板举着试吃记录，它只能证明哪几只被吃过。召回人员整夜核对包装批号，集市摊位陆续关闭。陈老板退还货款，也承担就医索赔。试吃者吃到的是安全肉饼，却一直追问自己的嘴为何什么都没报告。
第二天，食品安全团队没有先进账房，而是跟着一盘肉饼走：从融冰的送货筐，经过生肉案、烤炉和冷却间，直到包装桌。陈老板拿着粉笔。危险可能进入或增长的地方，工人先挂红牌；靠修好清洁、供应商检查或生熟分隔便能管住的，整改后摘牌。墙上最后只留下两处：必须照规定完成的炉角加热，以及不能凭手感猜测的冷却计时。陈老板封掉成品架旁的生肉案，请木匠加隔板，为此又停产一天。

第一次试行，工人把炉角读数写在推车编号旁。读数没有达到规定条件，她便在车把上系红色封条，包装桌停了。送货伙计指着门外等候的集市买家：肉饼看着已经好了，续约全靠这车货。陈老板还是把车推进扣货链后。修炉工找到半堵的供火管，另一只经检查的仪器也确认了原读数。复核记录时，一处空白又暴露出另一车未经记录便通过的肉饼，那辆车也被封住。集市官员要求两车全部销毁。陈老板在见证人面前剪开封条，把肉饼倒进处理槽，也丢掉了续约合同。他把两车损失写在各自批号旁。试吃勺一直没有沾到肉饼。
数月后，同一只角落火头再次熄灭。读数在推车到包装桌前触发预定反应，红色扣货牌让它停下，工人按本坊文件继续处理。陈老板放下试吃勺，在牌后签名。旧黄铜合格章干净地挂在桌上，没有顾客再替它发出警报。
articles.conceptName: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points
articles.conceptNameZh: 危害分析与关键控制点
explanationParagraphs: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points is a preventive food-safety system. For a specific product and process, it identifies significant hazards, determines points where control is essential, sets validated critical limits, monitors them, and applies corrective action to deviations. Verification, records, and review show whether the system works. Prerequisite programmes such as sanitation support the plan; finished-product sampling can verify performance but cannot replace continuous process control.
explanationParagraphsZh: 危害分析与关键控制点是一套预防性食品安全体系：针对具体产品和流程识别重大危害，确定必须控制的关键点，设定经验证的限值并监测，偏离时执行纠正行动，再通过验证、记录和复核确认体系有效。清洁等前提方案支撑整个计划；成品抽检可用于验证，却无法替代过程中的持续控制。
